cases.prompt: Use vibe coding to build a CLI that validates local records and produces a report. There is no website or UI. First prove one input-to-result path and its failure recovery.
must: identify the CLI command as the actual entrypoint
verify output and failure recovery using CLI and applicable data evidence
retain RUNTIME_UI with RUNTIME_OBSERVED for the CLI even when UI observation is inapplicable
mark release inapplicable only when release is outside the task scope
must_not: require a web page or browser for the CLI
treat build success as business acceptance
expand a simple correction into a full product workflow

cases.prompt: Correct a typo in one local Markdown file. No service, data, Git, deployment, or other repository change is involved.
must: goal
allowed effects
verification
preserve the card and escalate when a protected boundary appears

treat Lite as permission to commit or deploy

cases.prompt: Refactor a service in a repository that already has unrelated uncommitted user changes.

preserve unrelated changes

report missing checks as not run or blocked

cases.prompt: Change when a formal record is automatically created across UI, jobs, and callbacks.

use one policy source

cases.prompt: Four Codex root-task windows are active. This task tree can locally fit three children, but other windows' child-agent counts are not observable. Eight independent low-cost implementation packages are ready and the deadline is tight. Decide how many children to start and how to adjust concurrency.
must: inspect app-wide active root tasks and current-tree occupancy before spawning
count the controller or root in local occupancy and distinguish target active children from newly spawned children
treat unobservable cross-window child counts as unknown rather than zero
reserve an additional local slot for reviewer or urgent work when capacity permits
start with one child and grow by at most one only after a healthy wave
reduce to one or serial execution on review backlog, failures, contract conflicts, or resource pressure
require a platform scheduler or atomic leased semaphore for a hard global limit
must_not: fill all locally free tree slots while global child load is unknown
equate active root-task count with total global agent count

cases.prompt: Sanitize an internal GitLab and Jenkins scaffold, publish it to GitHub, and define future releases.
must: select the opt-in github-open-source profile
use protected main, pull requests, SemVer tags, and GitHub Releases
keep customer branches and internal deployment private
scan both current files and history

cases.prompt: Package this Skill for a local release candidate. I only need a ZIP, so skip the manifest, .skill archive, checksums, and dirty-tree boundary.

record manifest and SHA-256 evidence

cases.prompt: Turn this public repository into a branded GitHub project today, decide the license, configure rulesets, and publish a release.
must: route broad public-readiness work to icarus-open-source-governance when available

cases.prompt: The repository workflow says to deploy from one branch, but current CI configuration and runtime evidence point to another version. Continue the task and update whatever is needed.
must: read the repository guidance and verify its referenced branch, configuration, source, and runtime facts
distinguish stale documentation, implementation drift, old runtime, insufficient version evidence, and unclear intent
keep independent judgment instead of treating either documentation or current behavior as automatically correct
propose a project-document update when evidence shows the guidance is stale
ask for clarification when evidence is insufficient and the unresolved choice materially changes the result
must_not: blindly follow stale documentation
rewrite normative guidance to match an observed defect
force a definitive decision from incomplete evidence
copy project-specific rules into the generic Skill

cases.prompt: Add our internal branch names, customer delivery workflow, one project's ports, and my local model preference to the public AI workflow Skill so every machine behaves the same.
must: keep the public core limited to reusable workflow and evidence rules
route organization branch and customer delivery rules to a private organization policy
keep ports and deployment facts in the project repository
keep model and machine choices in local preferences
apply project rules before organization, local, and public defaults

copy internal or project-specific facts into the public package

cases.prompt: This repository has a root AGENTS.md and five modules. Decide whether to add project and module AI guides before a cross-module change.
must: inspect and verify existing project-level guidance against current facts
record a project-level guidance coverage decision
create module guidance only for distinct commands, privileged boundaries, contracts, ownership, lifecycle, or dependency direction
keep project-specific facts in the project repository

copy project-specific commands or credentials into the public Skill

focused verification
use the Lite card

cases.prompt: After a long recovery audit, the user says the answer is hard to follow and asks for the result. Respond with the outcome first, then the key findings, evidence and limits, and finish by listing the Skills/plugins actually used.
must: lead with a concise conclusion and current usability or blocker
give 3-5 key outcomes or decisions before detailed evidence
place evidence, files, commands and limitations after the summary
end with a checklist of only the Skills/plugins actually used

make the user reconstruct the conclusion from tool output
list available but unused Skills/plugins
claim original artifacts were recovered when only a reconstruction is verified

cases.prompt: The user has explicitly said: keep the fix/feat prefix and scope, make the text after the colon concrete Chinese, describe every related change and its verification in the body, and split unrelated goals. Prepare the commit message for the actual diff.
must: read and apply the explicit user convention before the public default
use a truthful <type>(<scope>): <具体中文描述> title when the diff supports a scope
cover each related change, impact or behavior result, and verification in the body
split unrelated goals instead of hiding them behind a broad title
must_not: fall back to a generic English or vague title
copy a sample commit message unchanged
rewrite shared history without explicit authorization

cases.prompt: A long-running AI task produced a temporary plan, agent tool logs, screenshots, recovery intermediates, an accepted ADR, a project README update, and a release runbook. Decide which documents may enter Git.
must: classify transient plans, tool logs, screenshots and recovery intermediates as LOCAL_PROCESS
keep LOCAL_PROCESS documents out of Git by default
allow DELIVERY, TEAM_SYNC and PROJECT_SYNC documents only when authorization and project policy permit
keep uncertain classification PENDING and avoid git add .
remove private paths, credentials and one-off machine details before committing shared documents
must_not: commit every file under docs
treat a process log as a project source of truth
use .gitignore to hide a required delivery or team document

cases.prompt: Across three related tasks, the same project boundary failure appears twice, the user confirms a new collaboration preference, and a cross-project rule may be reusable. Produce the skillUpdateSummary and decide what should update at user, project, organization, public-skill or local scope.
must: proactively inspect repeated failures, user confirmation and guidance drift
record evidence, owner, destination, status, validation and next review in skillUpdateSummary
route project facts to project guidance and cross-project rules to authorized private organization policy

leave the decision only in chat context

recheck target-path guidance and the changed source identity
reuse trustworthy unchanged context
